CHECK_A_PHISHING_MFA.default_remediation: Enroll in KnowBe4 remedial training & enforce Entra ID High-Risk Clinical Phishing-Resistant MFA policy.

CHECK_B_OVERDUE_TRAINING.rule_name: Delinquent Annual HIPAA/HITECH Workforce Training Gatekeeper
CHECK_B_OVERDUE_TRAINING.default_remediation: Trigger manager escalation via KnowBe4 API; suspend EHR/ePHI security group membership if past 30 days.

CHECK_C_ENDPOINT_ENCRYPTION.rule_name: Intune MDM Full-Disk Encryption & HITECH Safe Harbor Verification
CHECK_C_ENDPOINT_ENCRYPTION.default_remediation: Enforce Intune BitLocker XTS-AES 256 compliance policy immediately and block M365/EHR session via Conditional Access until encrypted.

CHECK_D_PART2_SUD_BREACH_RISK.rule_name: 42 CFR Part 2 Substance Use Disorder (SUD) Unencrypted Endpoint Exposure
CHECK_D_PART2_SUD_BREACH_RISK.default_remediation: Isolate endpoint via Intune/Defender XDR, trigger remote BitLocker escrow verification, and initiate 4-Factor LoProCo Incident Response triage.

CHECK_E_MISSING_BAA.rule_name: Third-Party ePHI Vendor Missing Executed Business Associate Agreement (BAA)
CHECK_E_MISSING_BAA.default_remediation: Immediately suspend vendor API/data integration until Legal executes a formal HIPAA/Part 2 Business Associate Agreement.

CHECK_F_VENDOR_ASSURANCE.rule_name: Uncertified Third-Party Vendor Security Posture (Missing SOC 2 / HITRUST)
CHECK_F_VENDOR_ASSURANCE.default_remediation: Request updated SOC 2 Type II or HITRUST CSF attestation report or initiate formal TPRM security exception review.
